title_vi: Chọn hệ thống tin nhắn: tin bị lấy đi, phát đi hay giữ lại

source_snapshot.note: Pinned commit/path body read from a partial clone of the source repository; git hash-object of the retrieved body matches the source-map blob. No source-image bytes used.

related.reason_vi: Giao nhiều nhất một lần, ít nhất một lần và đúng một lần.
Kafka là một hệ thống kiểu nhật ký.
Kiến trúc hàng đợi tin nhắn thay đổi qua các thế hệ.

claims.evidence: Redis docs (lists, LMOVE reliable-queue pattern, Pub/Sub delivery semantics, streams) and Kafka docs (introduction, design: consumer position) were read from partial clones of redis/docs and apache/kafka; the three-model result comes from the author's run on Redis 7.0.15 on 2026-10-18 (redis-py, no persistence).

mobile.evidence: Chromium (Playwright) rendered lesson.md (markdown-it, tables enabled, every <details> open, a 16 px page gutter) at each width: the page never scrolled sideways and the figure was scaled to the column; the smallest SVG font-size times that scale is the recorded minimum at 320 px. `python3 -m scripts.figures check --browser` measured every line of the figure in Chromium inside its box. Not GitHub, not a real phone and not learner testing.

claims.claim_vi: A Redis list used with LPUSH and BRPOP works as a queue in which each element reaches a single blocked client; the LMOVE reliable-queue pattern notes that such a queue can lose messages if the consumer crashes after receiving one.
claims.section: Lists: blocking operations; LMOVE: Pattern: reliable queue
claims.verified_by: Read from a partial clone of redis/docs at commit 3b030c7ef066c0bb7f88ddec02c784e49783b0f8.

claims.claim_vi: Redis Pub/Sub has at-most-once delivery: a message the subscriber cannot handle is lost forever; stream messages are persisted and support at-most-once and at-least-once.
claims.verified_by: Read from a partial clone of redis/docs at commit 3b030c7ef066c0bb7f88ddec02c784e49783b0f8.

claims.claim_vi: A Redis stream is an append-only log; a consumer group keeps its own last-delivered ID, can be created at 0 to consume the whole history or at $ for new messages only, tracks pending messages and needs XACK.
claims.verified_by: Read from a partial clone of redis/docs at commit 3b030c7ef066c0bb7f88ddec02c784e49783b0f8.

claims.claim_vi: In Kafka, events are not deleted after consumption but retained per a per-topic setting, and a consumer can rewind its offset to re-consume data.
claims.section: Main concepts and terminology; Consumer Position
claims.verified_by: Read from a partial clone of apache/kafka at commit 65566690ca1ddb584388c1026e2ff6673e9c6f19 (trunk).

claims.claim_vi: Measured on Redis 7.0.15: list worker 1 got m1 and m2, worker 2 got m3, a late worker got nothing; PUBLISH returned 1 then 2 receivers and the late subscriber only got m2; a stream read fully by group billing and by group email created later at 0, length still 3, three pending for billing before XACK.
claims.verified_by: Author's own run on 2026-10-18 with redis-py; one machine, persistence off.

claims.claim_vi: Eight criteria for choosing a message queue: speed, scalability, reliability, durability, ease of use, ecosystem, integration, protocol support.

design_notes_vi: Ba thẻ cho ba cách giao tin, mỗi thẻ ghi kết quả thử; bốn câu hỏi thay cho bảng chấm điểm sản phẩm. Không dùng ảnh nguồn.
source_deviations: The source lists eight product criteria and suggests trying Kafka; the lesson instead groups systems by what happens to a message after delivery (queue, Pub/Sub, log) and shows all three on one Redis server.
The lesson does not rank products or measure speed.
editorial_note_vi: Bài mới viết trong kho này, chờ review kỹ thuật. Chưa user testing hoặc phê duyệt phát hành.
